description: Persistent regression bank for supported and intentionally unsupported ontology questions. Keep old questions here unless the product contract changes on purpose.

cases.question: Show me the top 10 players by points over the last 10 games
cases.notes: Canonical top-N ranking question retained as a core regression.

cases.question: Who are the top 10 scorers over the last 10 games?
cases.notes: Lexical scorer variant retained to protect interpretation coverage.

cases.question: Show me the top 10 players by pts over the last 10 games
cases.notes: Abbreviation variant retained to protect alias mapping.

cases.question: Show me the top 5 players by points over the last 10 games
cases.notes: Limit-handling variant retained to protect query-shape flexibility.

cases.question: What is the trend in points over the last month?
cases.notes: Retained narrow failure case until trend analysis is intentionally implemented.

cases.question: Compare Brunson and Haliburton scoring over the last 10 games
cases.notes: Canonical comparison question retained as the first SQL+Python style comparison path.

Compare Brunson and Haliburton pts over the last 10 games

cases.question: Compare Ja and Tatum scoring over the last 10 games
cases.notes: Generalized player comparison using a unique first-name alias plus a unique family-name alias.

cases.question: Compare Jalen and Tatum scoring over the last 10 games

cases.question: Show me players and their assists over the last 10 games

Show me players by avg points over the last 10 games
